papers.title: Impact of a Culturally Tailored Educational Intervention on Human Papillomavirus Knowledge and Vaccination Intentions Among Women in Saudi Arabia: Quasi-Experimental Study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is one of the most common sexually transmitted infections worldwide. Despite the availability of effective vaccines, uptake remains suboptimal in many settings, including Saudi Arabia, where cultural sensitivities, limited awareness, and vaccine hesitancy have been documented. Educational interventions grounded in behavioral theory, such as the information-motivation-behavioral skills (IMB) model, can help address informational and motivational barriers to HPV vaccination. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate the impact of an educational intervention in improving HPV vaccination decision-making among women in Northern Saudi Arabia. METHODS: A quasi-experimental design (pretest-posttest with a control group) was used among women attending primary health care centers in the Northern Border Region of Saudi Arabia. A total of 380 participants, 190 in the control group and 190 in the intervention group, completed surveys at baseline (T1), 1-week post intervention (T2), and a 3-month follow-up (T3), assessing HPV-related knowledge, health awareness, attitudes, and vaccination intentions. The educational intervention consisted of a culturally adapted, evidence-based, 45-minute interactive group session delivered in primary health care centers. RESULTS: Study retention was excellent (380/389, 97.7%). At the 3-month follow-up, intervention participants demonstrated medium to large effect size improvements compared with controls: knowledge (adjusted β=0.84, 95% CI 0.53-1.15; P .10), suggesting consistent intervention effects across demographic characteristics. CONCLUSIONS: This culturally tailored educational intervention was effective in improving HPV-related knowledge, attitudes, health awareness, and vaccination intentions among women in Northern Saudi Arabia. Given the well-documented intention-behavior gap in vaccination uptake, future research should incorporate verified vaccine initiation and completion outcomes, along with longer follow-up, to assess whether enhanced intentions translate into actual vaccine uptake.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人乳头瘤病毒(人乳头瘤病毒,HPV)是全球最常见的性传播感染之一。尽管有有效的疫苗(抗病毒药物)可用,但在许多地区,包括沙特阿拉伯,其接种率仍不理想,这与文化敏感性、有限的认知以及疫苗(抗病毒药物)接种犹豫有关。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在沙特阿拉伯北方边境地区初级卫生保健中心参加活动的女性中,采用准实验设计(基线前测-后测与对照组)。共有380名参与者,其中190名在对照组,190名在干预组,分别在基线(T1)、干预后1周(T2)和随访3个月(T3)时完成调查,评估与HPV相关的知识、健康意识、态度和疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)意愿。
elements_zh.methods: 教育干预包括一项文化适应性、基于证据的、45分钟的互动小组课程,由初级卫生保健中心提供。
elements_zh.main_results: Study retention was excellent (380/389, 97.7%). At the 3-month follow-up, intervention participants demonstrated medium to large effect size improvements compared with controls: knowledge (adjusted β=0.84, 95% CI 0.53-1.15; P .10), suggesting consistent intervention effects across demographic characteristics.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项文化定制的教育干预在提高沙特阿拉伯北方女性对HPV相关知识、态度、健康意识和疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)意愿方面是有效的。基于行为理论的教育干预,如信息-动机-行为技能(IMB)模型,有助于解决HPV 疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)的信息和动机障碍。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 鉴于在疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)接种中已记录的意愿与行为之间的差距,未来的研究应纳入已验证的疫苗(抗病毒药物)接种启动和完成结果,并进行更长时间的随访,以评估增强的意愿是否转化为实际的疫苗(抗病毒药物)接种行为。本研究提供了证据,表明文化定制的教育干预可以提高沙特阿拉伯北方女性对HPV相关知识和疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)意愿的理解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告研究的局限性。由于采用准实验设计,并且主要基于自我报告的结果,而未验证实际的疫苗(抗病毒药物)接种启动或完成情况,因此该研究的证据强度中等。

papers.title: Study of Human Papillomavirus Vaccine-Related Social Media Content Across Eight Social Media Platforms: Scoping Review of Communication Content, Information Sources, and Analytical Approaches.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Social media has become an important channel for health information dissemination and public discussion of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination. Previous reviews have examined social media and HPV vaccination, often focusing on single platforms, broader HPV-related topics, or the potential effects on knowledge, leaving limited cross-platform synthesis specifically focused on HPV vaccine–related communication content, information sources, and analytical approaches. Objective This scoping review aimed to map and synthesize peer-reviewed studies examining HPV vaccine–related social media content, with particular attention to communication content, information sources, and methodological characteristics. Methods Following the PRISMA-ScR (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews) guidelines, we searched PubMed, Web of Science, MEDLINE, Embase, and Scopus on June 10, 2026. Backward and forward citation searches were completed on July 17, 2026. We included peer-reviewed English-language original studies published between 2006 and 2026 that analyzed HPV vaccine–related communication content on social media. Data were charted using a structured extraction form and synthesized descriptively. No formal risk-of-bias assessment was conducted. Results A total of 50 studies published between 2012 and 2026 met the eligibility criteria. Eight social media platforms were represented, with X (formerly Twitter; X Corp) most frequently studied, followed by Weibo (Weibo Corporation), and YouTube (Google LLC). HPV vaccine–related communication content was synthesized into 5 categories: risk- and concern-oriented, benefit- and prevention-oriented, misinformation- and distrust-related, experiential and narrative, and practical and policy-related communication. Across studies, prevention and benefit messages coexisted with safety concerns, side effects, access barriers, misinformation, distrust, and personal narratives. Personal accounts were often associated with experiential narratives or negative sentiment, whereas professional sources were less common but generally provided more informative or higher-quality content. Analytical approaches included content analysis, sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and network analysis, but theoretical frameworks were applied in only a minority of studies. Conclusions The evidence was limited by heterogeneity in platforms, sampling strategies, data collection periods, coding schemes, and analytical methods, limiting direct comparison across studies. Because most studies analyzed publicly available social media content, this review could not determine individual-level exposure, interpretation, vaccination intention, or vaccine uptake. Overall, HPV vaccine discourse cannot be adequately understood through sentiment polarity alone. This review provides a cross-platform, content-focused synthesis of how HPV vaccine–related social media communication has been studied. Unlike previous reviews, this review clarifies how HPV vaccine–related content has been described, who generates it, and which methods have been used to analyze it. These findings support theory-informed, platform-sensitive research and may inform public health communication strategies, including evidence-based education, transparent risk communication, credible source engagement, narrative-informed messaging, misinformation monitoring, and improved information quality.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 根据范围审查的PRISMA-ScR指南,我们在2026年6月10日搜索了PubMed、Web of Science、MEDLINE、Embase和Scopus。纳入了2006年至2026年间发表的英语原创同行评审研究,这些研究分析了社交媒体上的HPV 疫苗相关的沟通内容。数据使用结构化提取表进行记录,并进行了描述性综合。未进行正式的偏倚风险评估。在2026年7月17日完成了引文追溯和引文追踪。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: HPV 疫苗相关的沟通内容被综合为5类:风险和担忧导向的、益处和预防导向的、错误信息和不信任相关的、经验性和叙述性的以及实用性和政策导向的沟通。在研究中,预防和益处信息与安全担忧、副作用、访问障碍、错误信息、不信任和个人叙述共存。个人账户通常与经验性叙述或负面情绪相关,而专业来源较少但通常提供了更具有信息性或高质量的内容。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 证据受到平台、采样策略、数据收集时期、编码方案和分析方法的异质性限制,限制了研究间的直接比较。大多数研究分析了公开可用的社交媒体内容,因此本综述无法确定个体暴露、解释、HPV意图或HPV 疫苗的接受度。本综述还指出,仅通过情感极性无法充分捕捉HPV 疫苗讨论的复杂性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 这些发现支持理论导向、平台敏感的研究,并可能指导公共卫生沟通策略,包括基于证据的教育、透明的风险沟通、可信来源的参与、叙述导向的信息传递、错误信息监测和提高信息质量。

papers.title: Diagnostic accuracy of menstrual blood for human papillomavirus detection in cervical cancer screening: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: Cervical cancer is a major global health burden, disproportionately affecting women in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), where access to traditional human papillomavirus (HPV) screening is limited. Menstrual blood (MB), a non-invasive and passively collectable biospecimen, may offer a culturally acceptable alternative. This review evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of MB-based high-risk HPV detection compared to clinician-collected cervical samples. METHODS: We included diagnostic accuracy studies and randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating self-collected MB for high-risk HPV detection in asymptomatic women aged 25-65 years. Eligible studies reported sensitivity, specificity, or 2×2 data using clinician-collected cervical samples as the reference. We searched PubMed, Embase, and Google Scholar up to July 7, 2025. Risk of bias was assessed via QUADAS-3, and a bivariate random-effects model estimated pooled sensitivity and specificity. Certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE. RESULTS: Seven studies (n = 1,297 participants; 586 reference-positive, 711 reference-negative) met inclusion criteria. The pooled sensitivity and specificity of MB-based HPV testing were 0.86 (95% CI: 0.80-0.90) and 0.90 (95% CI: 0.72-0.97), respectively. The diagnostic odds ratio was 56 (95% CI: 19-166), and the area under the hierarchical SROC curve was 0.90 (95% CI: 0.87-0.92), indicating high overall diagnostic performance. However, high heterogeneity (I2 = 94%) and threshold effects were observed. No significant publication bias was detected (Deeks' p = 0.62). CONCLUSIONS: MB-based HPV testing demonstrates high diagnostic accuracy and emerges as a non-invasive alternative for cervical cancer screening, especially in underserved settings. Further validation in diverse populations is warranted.

papers.title_zh: 月经血用于人乳头瘤病毒检测在宫颈癌筛查中的诊断准确性:一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
papers.source_body_en: PURPOSE: Cervical cancer is a major global health burden, disproportionately affecting women in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), where access to traditional human papillomavirus (HPV) screening is limited. Menstrual blood (MB), a non-invasive and passively collectable biospecimen, may offer a culturally acceptable alternative. This review evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of MB-based high-risk HPV detection compared to clinician-collected cervical samples. METHODS: We included diagnostic accuracy studies and randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating self-collected MB for high-risk HPV detection in asymptomatic women aged 25-65 years. Eligible studies reported sensitivity, specificity, or 2×2 data using clinician-collected cervical samples as the reference. We searched PubMed, Embase, and Google Scholar up to July 7, 2025. Risk of bias was assessed via QUADAS-3, and a bivariate random-effects model estimated pooled sensitivity and specificity. Certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE. RESULTS: Seven studies (n = 1,297 participants; 586 reference-positive, 711 reference-negative) met inclusion criteria. The pooled sensitivity and specificity of MB-based HPV testing were 0.86 (95% CI: 0.80-0.90) and 0.90 (95% CI: 0.72-0.97), respectively. The diagnostic odds ratio was 56 (95% CI: 19-166), and the area under the hierarchical SROC curve was 0.90 (95% CI: 0.87-0.92), indicating high overall diagnostic performance. However, high heterogeneity (I2 = 94%) and threshold effects were observed. No significant publication bias was detected (Deeks' p = 0.62). CONCLUSIONS: MB-based HPV testing demonstrates high diagnostic accuracy and emerges as a non-invasive alternative for cervical cancer screening, especially in underserved settings. Further validation in diverse populations is warranted.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的:宫颈癌是全球主要的健康负担,尤其在低收入和中等收入国家(LMICs)中对女性影响更大,这些地区传统人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)筛查的可及性有限。月经血(MB)作为一种非侵入性且可被动收集的生物样本,可能提供一种文化上可接受的替代方案。本综述评估了基于月经血的高危型HPV检测与由临床医生收集的宫颈样本相比的诊断准确性。方法:我们纳入了评估自取月经血用于高危型HPV检测的诊断准确性研究和随机对照试验(RCTs),研究对象为无症状的25-65岁女性。符合纳入标准的研究报告了使用临床医生收集的宫颈样本作为参考的敏感性、特异性或2×2数据。我们于2025年7月7日之前在PubMed、Embase和Google Scholar上进行了检索。偏倚风险通过QUADAS-3进行评估,采用双变量随机效应模型估计汇总敏感性和特异性。证据的确定性使用GRADE进行评估。结果:七项研究(n = 1,297名参与者;586名参考阳性,711名参考阴性)符合纳入标准。基于月经血的HPV检测的汇总敏感性和特异性分别为0.86(95% CI:0.80-0.90)和0.90(95% CI:0.72-0.97)。诊断比值比为56(95% CI:19-166),层次SROC曲线下的面积为0.90(95% CI:0.87-0.92),表明总体诊断性能较高。然而,观察到高度异质性(I2 = 94%)和阈值效应。未检测到显著的发表偏倚(Deeks' p = 0.62)。结论:基于月经血的HPV检测显示出高诊断准确性,并成为宫颈癌筛查的一种非侵入性替代方案,特别是在服务不足的地区。需要在多样化的群体中进一步验证。

papers.title: PDS0101 With Pembrolizumab in HPV16-Positive Recurrent/Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma: A Phase 2 Nonrandomized Clinical Trial.
papers.abstract: IMPORTANCE: The incidence of human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16-positive) recurrent/metastatic (R/M) head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is rising. Approved therapies offer a durable response to a minority of patients. OBJECTIVE: To determine the efficacy and safety of a therapeutic HPV16-targeted immunotherapy, PDS0101, in combination with pembrolizumab in participants with HPV16-positive R/M HNSCC, with separate evaluation of immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)-naive and ICI-resistant cohorts. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: VERSATILE-002 was a phase 2, open-label, multicenter nonrandomized clinical trial conducted at 26 oncology centers from March 29, 2021, to May 15, 2025, across the US, UK, and Ireland using the Simon 2-stage optimal design. Efficacy analyses were performed on modified intent-to-treat (mITT) population; safety analyses included all participants who received 1 or more doses. Eighty-eight participants with histologically confirmed R/M HPV16-positive HNSCC were enrolled, of whom 87 (98.9%) received treatment and composed the safety population. Seventy five (85.2%) were in the mITT population used for efficacy analyses, of whom 53 (70.7%) were ICI-naive with a programmed cell death ligand 1 combined positive score of 1 or greater and 22 (29.3%) were ICI-resistant. EXPOSURES: Pembrolizumab (200 mg, intravenously, every 3 weeks for up to 35 cycles) plus subcutaneous PDS0101 (5 scheduled doses per protocol). MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary end point was objective response rate (ORR) per the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors, version 1.1, by a masked independent central reviewer. Secondary end points included progression-free survival (PFS), median overall survival (mOS), and safety, with exploratory end points of duration of response, disease control rate, and response rates by programmed cell death ligand 1 status. RESULTS: Of the 75 patients in the mITT population, the mean (SD) age was 64.0 (8.3) years; 4 individuals (5%) were female and 71 (95%) were male; and 2 individuals (3%) were Asian, 1 (1%) was Black, 5 (7%) were Hispanic, and 71 (95%) were White. Among 53 ICI-naive participants in the mITT cohort, ORR by the central reviewer was 34.0%, median PFS was 5.3 months (95% CI, 2.10-9.00), and mOS was 39.3 months (95% CI, 23.90 to not evaluable). Among 22 ICI-resistant patients in the mITT cohort, no objective responses were observed and the primary end point (ORR by central reviewer) was not met, but mOS was 14.8 months (95% CI, 8.50-26.00). The treatment was well tolerated, with 13.8% experiencing grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: The results of this nonrandomized clinical trial suggest that PDS0101 plus pembrolizumab showed antitumor activity in ICI-naive HPV16-positive R/M HNSCC, with favorable safety, response rates, and survival outcomes. The findings support further evaluation in a first-line setting. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT04260126.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人乳头瘤病毒 16 型(HPV16 阳性)复发/转移性 (R/M) 头颈鳞状细胞癌 (HNSCC) 的 发病率 正在上升,批准的疗法可为少数患者提供持久的缓解。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: VERSATILE-002是一项2期、开放标签、多中心非随机临床试验,于2021年3月29日至2025年5月15日在美国、英国和爱尔兰的26个肿瘤中心使用西蒙2阶段优化设计进行。88 名经组织学证实为 R/M HPV16 阳性 HNSCC 的参与者入组,其中 87 名(98.9%)接受了 治疗 治疗,构成安全人群。75 例 (85.2%) 属于用于疗效分析的 mITT 人群,其中 53 例 (70.7%) 未接受过 ICI,程序性细胞死亡配体 1 综合阳性评分为 1 或更高,22 例 (29.3%) 具有 ICI 耐药性。
elements_zh.methods: PDS0101 是一种治疗性 HPV16 靶向免疫疗法,与派姆单抗(200 毫克,静脉注射,每 3 周一次,最多 35 个周期)加皮下注射 PDS0101(每个方案 5 次预定剂量)相结合。对 mITT 人群进行了功效分析,安全性分析包括所有接受 1 剂或以上剂量的参与者。
elements_zh.main_results: 在mITT人群中,75名患者中,平均(标准差)年龄为64.0(8.3)岁;4名个体(5%)为女性,71名(95%)为男性;2名(3%)为亚洲人,1名(1%)为黑人,5名(7%)为西班牙裔,71名(95%)为白人。在53名未接受过ICI治疗的参与者中,中央评审者的客观缓解率(ORR)为34.0%,中位无进展生存期(PFS)为5.3个月(95%置信区间,2.10-9.00),中位总生存期(OS)为39.3个月(95%置信区间,23.90至不可评估)。在22名对ICI耐药的患者中,未观察到客观反应,且主要终点(中央评审者的ORR)未达成,但中位总生存期(OS)为14.8个月(95%置信区间,8.50-26.00)。

papers.title_zh: PDS0101 与 Pembrolizumab 联合治疗 HPV16 阳性复发/转移性头颈鳞状细胞癌:2 期非随机临床试验。
papers.source_body_en: IMPORTANCE: The incidence of human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16-positive) recurrent/metastatic (R/M) head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is rising. Approved therapies offer a durable response to a minority of patients. OBJECTIVE: To determine the efficacy and safety of a therapeutic HPV16-targeted immunotherapy, PDS0101, in combination with pembrolizumab in participants with HPV16-positive R/M HNSCC, with separate evaluation of immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)-naive and ICI-resistant cohorts. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: VERSATILE-002 was a phase 2, open-label, multicenter nonrandomized clinical trial conducted at 26 oncology centers from March 29, 2021, to May 15, 2025, across the US, UK, and Ireland using the Simon 2-stage optimal design. Efficacy analyses were performed on modified intent-to-treat (mITT) population; safety analyses included all participants who received 1 or more doses. Eighty-eight participants with histologically confirmed R/M HPV16-positive HNSCC were enrolled, of whom 87 (98.9%) received treatment and composed the safety population. Seventy five (85.2%) were in the mITT population used for efficacy analyses, of whom 53 (70.7%) were ICI-naive with a programmed cell death ligand 1 combined positive score of 1 or greater and 22 (29.3%) were ICI-resistant. EXPOSURES: Pembrolizumab (200 mg, intravenously, every 3 weeks for up to 35 cycles) plus subcutaneous PDS0101 (5 scheduled doses per protocol). MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary end point was objective response rate (ORR) per the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors, version 1.1, by a masked independent central reviewer. Secondary end points included progression-free survival (PFS), median overall survival (mOS), and safety, with exploratory end points of duration of response, disease control rate, and response rates by programmed cell death ligand 1 status. RESULTS: Of the 75 patients in the mITT population, the mean (SD) age was 64.0 (8.3) years; 4 individuals (5%) were female and 71 (95%) were male; and 2 individuals (3%) were Asian, 1 (1%) was Black, 5 (7%) were Hispanic, and 71 (95%) were White. Among 53 ICI-naive participants in the mITT cohort, ORR by the central reviewer was 34.0%, median PFS was 5.3 months (95% CI, 2.10-9.00), and mOS was 39.3 months (95% CI, 23.90 to not evaluable). Among 22 ICI-resistant patients in the mITT cohort, no objective responses were observed and the primary end point (ORR by central reviewer) was not met, but mOS was 14.8 months (95% CI, 8.50-26.00). The treatment was well tolerated, with 13.8% experiencing grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: The results of this nonrandomized clinical trial suggest that PDS0101 plus pembrolizumab showed antitumor activity in ICI-naive HPV16-positive R/M HNSCC, with favorable safety, response rates, and survival outcomes. The findings support further evaluation in a first-line setting. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT04260126.

papers.title: Regulation and function of the HPV16 CircE7 RNA.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT High-risk human papillomaviruses (HPV), including HPV16, produce circular RNA that encompasses the E7 oncogene (circE7). CircE7 can be detected in HPV16-positive cells and tumors, is preferentially localized to the cytoplasm, is N 6 -methyladenosine (m 6 A)-modified, and can be translated into the E7 oncoprotein. Here, we explored the regulation and function of circE7. Mutation of m 6 A motifs flanking the backsplice junction revealed a single m 6 A motif to be essential for circE7 formation. Mutation of this m 6 A motif promoted linear splicing of the E6*I splice site (226^409), suggesting that linear and circular E7 splicing are inversely regulated. Additionally, mutation of an IRES-like motif in circE7 significantly decreased E7 protein expression, without having significant effects on circE7 RNA levels. Knockdown of YTHDC1, but not other m 6 A-binding proteins, decreased both circE7 RNA and protein expression. BaseScope ISH was used to confirm the expression of circE7 in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma cell lines and tumors. Using both qRT-PCR and BaseScope ISH, we found that serum and amino acid starvation significantly increased circE7. Finally, we generated an HPV16 genome with mutations in the circE7 m 6 A motif (Mut2). Stable transduction of primary keratinocytes with Mut2 confirmed the loss of circE7 and increased expression of E6*I. The Mut2 HPV16 genome exhibited significantly decreased viral replication but an increased ability to transform primary keratinocytes. Our studies reveal that the precise regulation of circE7 and E6*I by m 6 A is critical for the ability of HPV16 to infect and transform keratinocytes. IMPORTANCE High-risk human papillomaviruses (HPVs), such as HPV16, must carefully control how much E6 and E7 proteins they make. This study shows that HPV16 toggles a single chemical tag on the viral RNA (an m6A mark) to control the production of early region RNAs, including a circular RNA called circE7. The same site coordinately regulates splicing of the E6*I isoform. CircE7 uses m6A-binding proteins to control its production and a specific sequence to promote its translation. It is present in HPV-positive cancers and can respond to nutrient starvation. Regulation of circE7 through this m 6 A site also impacted viral replication and transformation capacity, indicating that this regulatory mechanism is critical for HPV biology.

papers.title: PCR-LbCas12a Assay for Genotyping of HPV 16 and 18.
papers.abstract: CRISPR/Cas12a systems have been widely used in nucleic acid detection, because of their high specificity and trans-cleavage activity. We combined the specificity of CRISPR/Cas12a system with the sensitivity of PCR, to develop a new HPV detection assay with high specificity and sensitivity, called PCR-LbCas12a assay. Here, we pre-amplified almost all high-risk HPV genotypes with consensus primer (MY09/11) and added to new tubes containing HPV 16 or 18 CRISPR/Cas12a system for HPV genotyping. The LOD of PCR-LbCas12a for HPV16 or HPV18 DNA was 100 copies and 10 copies per reaction, respectively. In mixed samples of HPV 16 and HPV 18 DNA, PCR-LbCas12a assay could detect HPV16 DNA from samples containing 10 2 copies of HPV16 and 10 4 copies of HPV18. On the other hand, HPV18 DNA was detected from samples containing 10 3 copies of HPV16 and HPV18, respectively. Following validation with HPV-positive and HPV-negative cell lines (SiHa, HeLa, and C-33A), the PCR-LbCas12a assay was evaluated using 39 clinical samples previously characterized by type-specific qPCR. The assay demonstrated a sensitivity of 91.3 (95 CI 71.9-98.9) and a specificity of 100. The PCR-LbCas12a assay can discriminate the HPV 16 and HPV 18 genotypes, and holds great potential in simultaneous detection of most high-risk HPV genotypes including HPV 16 and HPV18.

papers.title: HUMAN PAPILLOMAVIRUS (HPV) INFECTION IN CARCINOGENESIS AND THE ROLE OF PROPHYLACTIC VACCINATION: A NARRATIVE REVIEW
papers.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is among the most prevalent sexually transmitted pathogens worldwide and an established cause of both benign proliferative lesions and malignant neoplasms. This narrative review examines the role of HPV infection in carcinogenesis at the principal anatomical sites involved and evaluates the contribution of prophylactic vaccination to disease control. A structured search of PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science was conducted for English-language publications available up to August 2026, supplemented by current guidance from international health authorities. The evidence confirms a causal role for high-risk genotypes, principally HPV-16 and HPV-18, in oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma and in cancers of the cervix, vulva, vagina, penis, and anus, mediated by the E6 and E7 oncoproteins through inactivation of the p53 and retinoblastoma pathways. The strength of this association is markedly site-dependent: it is well established in the oropharynx, cervix, and anus, but remains equivocal in the oral cavity and larynx. In oropharyngeal carcinoma, HPV status is an independent prognostic factor and is incorporated into current staging. Vaccination substantially reduces infection, precancerous lesions, and cervical cancer incidence, with the greatest benefit among individuals immunized before sexual debut. Vaccination and organized screening are complementary rather than alternative strategies, and suboptimal uptake-as observed in Poland-remains the principal barrier to realizing the full preventive potential of available vaccines.
papers.journal: International Journal of Innovative Technologies in Social Science

papers.source_body_en: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is among the most prevalent sexually transmitted pathogens worldwide and an established cause of both benign proliferative lesions and malignant neoplasms. papers.abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 是全世界最流行的性传播病原体之一,也是良性增殖性病变和恶性肿瘤的既定原因。这篇叙述性综述探讨了 HPV 感染在主要解剖部位癌变中的作用,并评估了预防性药物 疫苗接种 对疾病控制的贡献。对 PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus 和 Web of Science 进行了结构化检索,查找截至 2026 年 8 月可用的英文出版物,并辅以国际卫生当局的最新指南。证据证实高危基因型(主要是 HPV-16 和 HPV-18)在口咽鳞状细胞癌以及子宫颈、外阴、阴道、阴茎和肛门癌症中的因果作用,由 E6 和 E7 癌蛋白通过 p53 和视网膜母细胞瘤途径失活介导。这种关联的强度明显取决于部位:它在口咽、子宫颈和肛门中已得到很好的建立,但在口腔和喉中仍然模棱两可。在口咽癌中,HPV 状态是一个独立的预后因素,并已纳入当前的分期中。疫苗接种 显着减少感染、癌前病变和 宫颈癌 发病率,在首次性行为前免疫的个体中获益最大。疫苗接种 和有组织的筛查是互补而非替代策略,而在波兰观察到的次优吸收仍然是实现现有 疫苗 全面预防潜力的主要障碍。

papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Human papillomavirus is one of the most crucial determinants responsible for the progression of head-neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC). Here, we report partial L1 gene sequences of two high-risk etiological agents, HPV-16 and HPV-18, extracted through biopsies from multiple head-neck tissue regions of HNSCC patients in Bangladesh.

papers.title: Rationale and design of a clinical trial of a reduced dosing schedule for the nonavalent human papillomavirus vaccine in women living with HIV: The NOVA-HIV study.
papers.abstract: Virtually all cases of cervical cancer are caused by human papillomavirus (HPV). Women and people with a cervix living with HIV (women with HIV) are disproportionately impacted by cervical cancer; they experience higher rates of HPV infection and increased susceptibility to persistent HPV infection than women without HIV. HPV vaccination is highly effective for prevention of cervical cancer, and the World Health Organization currently recommends a one or two-dose HPV vaccination schedule for immunocompetent females. Although the approved nonavalent HPV (9vHPV) vaccine is highly safe, immunogenic, and efficacious in those without HIV, there are very few data in women with HIV. To address this knowledge gap, the NOVA-HIV study is designed as a Canadian multicenter, observer-blind, randomized, phase IV clinical trial of the 9vHPV vaccine in women with HIV aged 18-45 years. The primary objective is to determine whether peak anti-HPV16/18 geometric mean titers (GMTs) after two doses of 9vHPV vaccine are non-inferior to peak anti-HPV16/18 GMTs after three doses. The trial will enroll 275 women with HIV from 11 sites across five Canadian provinces. Participants are randomized 1:1 to receive the 9vHPV vaccine at the routine schedule (0/2/6 months) or extended schedule (0/6/12 months). Over 24 months, participants attend six or seven visits, where clinical data, blood, and vaginal samples are collected. Data generated could support the implementation of reduced-dose schedules in women with HIV, making vaccination more feasible, contributing to the elimination of cervical cancer, and accelerating global health equity.

papers.title_zh: 在 HIV 感染女性中减少非价 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗 给药方案的临床试验的基本原理和设计:NOVA-HIV 研究。
papers.source_body_en: Virtually all cases of cervical cancer are caused by human papillomavirus (HPV). Women and people with a cervix living with HIV (women with HIV) are disproportionately impacted by cervical cancer; they experience higher rates of HPV infection and increased susceptibility to persistent HPV infection than women without HIV. HPV vaccination is highly effective for prevention of cervical cancer, and the World Health Organization currently recommends a one or two-dose HPV vaccination schedule for immunocompetent females. Although the approved nonavalent HPV (9vHPV) vaccine is highly safe, immunogenic, and efficacious in those without HIV, there are very few data in women with HIV. To address this knowledge gap, the NOVA-HIV study is designed as a Canadian multicenter, observer-blind, randomized, phase IV clinical trial of the 9vHPV vaccine in women with HIV aged 18-45 years. The primary objective is to determine whether peak anti-HPV16/18 geometric mean titers (GMTs) after two doses of 9vHPV vaccine are non-inferior to peak anti-HPV16/18 GMTs after three doses. The trial will enroll 275 women with HIV from 11 sites across five Canadian provinces. Participants are randomized 1:1 to receive the 9vHPV vaccine at the routine schedule (0/2/6 months) or extended schedule (0/6/12 months). Over 24 months, participants attend six or seven visits, where clinical data, blood, and vaginal samples are collected. Data generated could support the implementation of reduced-dose schedules in women with HIV, making vaccination more feasible, contributing to the elimination of cervical cancer, and accelerating global health equity.

papers.title: Local carboxymethyl β-glucan and polycarbophil in women positive for human papillomavirus: a prospective observational study
papers.abstract: Background: High-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infections with normal or low-grade cervical cytology are generally managed through observation because many infections clear spontaneously. However, persistent infection, particularly in women over 35 years of age, may increase the risk of progression and lead to prolonged surveillance, repeated examinations and patient anxiety. This study evaluates the effectiveness of local treatment with carboxymethyl β-glucan and polycarbophil (Colpofix®) in achieving negativization of high-risk (HR) human papillomavirus (HPV) in a Spanish population of women with HR-HPV positivity. Methods: This prospective, non-randomized controlled, multi-centre study enrolled 533 women aged 25–65 with HR-HPV and normal cytology, atypical squamous cells of undetermined significance or low-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions. Conducted in real clinical settings, it involved a 3-month treatment or ‘wait-and-see’ approach, with final follow-up at 6 months. Statistical analysis included various tests such as the Mann– Whitney test, Fisher’s exact test and Pearson’s χ2 test. Results: At 6 months, HR-HPV negativity was observed in 50.1% of treated patients compared with 24.0% in the observation group (p<0.0001). Higher clearance rates were recorded across all HR-HPV genotypes. For HPV16, negativization occurred in 50.7% of treated patients versus 9.2% of controls (p=0.0291). Resolution of cervical ectopy was more frequent in the treatment group (42.6% versus 11.5%, p<0.0001). No adverse events were reported. Conclusions: Local treatment with carboxymethyl β-glucan and polycarbophil was associated with higher rates of HR-HPV negativization and ectopy resolution compared with observation alone at 6-month follow-up, supporting its use as a management option, particularly in women over 35 years of age. papers.title: Human Papillomavirus Vaccination as the Basis for Cervical Cancer Prevention: Current Status and Prospects in the Kyrgyz Republic
papers.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the primary etiological factor responsible for the development of cervical cancer and several other anogenital malignancies. According to the World Health Organization, more than 95% of cervical cancer cases are associated with persistent infection caused by high-risk HPV types. Currently, HPV vaccination is recognized as the most effective method for the primary prevention of cervical cancer and has been incorporated into national immunization programs in many countries worldwide. International experience has demonstrated a substantial reduction in the prevalence of HPV infection, high-grade cervical intraepithelial lesions, and invasive cervical cancer among vaccinated populations. The aim of this study was to analyze current evidence regarding HPV vaccination as an effective strategy for cervical cancer prevention and to assess the prospects for developing immunization programs in the Kyrgyz Republic. A review of national and international scientific literature, regulatory documents, and official statistical reports related to HPV prevention and vaccination was conducted. Data from the World Health Organization, the International Agency for Research on Cancer, and the Ministry of Health of the Kyrgyz Republic were analyzed. HPV vaccination was found to be a safe and highly effective method for preventing HPV-associated diseases. Analysis of international experience demonstrated a significant reduction in the prevalence of oncogenic HPV types, high-grade cervical lesions, and cervical cancer incidence following the implementation of large-scale vaccination programs. However, various organizational, social, and informational barriers continue to limit the effectiveness of immunization programs in a number of countries, including the Kyrgyz Republic. Expanding HPV vaccination coverage represents one of the most promising strategies for cervical cancer prevention. Further development and strengthening of immunization programs may substantially reduce the incidence of and mortality from HPV-associated diseases among the female population of the Kyrgyz Republic.

papers.title: Distribution of high-risk Human Papillomavirus genotypes in cervical specimen from women using real-time PCR (Abbott m2000), a retrospective analysis over five years at Centre Pasteur du Cameroun
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The human papillomavirus (high-risk, HR-HPV) is the leading cause of nearly all cervical cancers, whose burden remains particularly high in sub-Saharan Africa. This study aimed to describe the prevalence and distribution of HR-HPV genotypes among patients referred to the Centre Pasteur du Cameroun (CPC) between 2021 and 2025, and to assess the association between age and the genotype identified. Methods Analytical cross-sectional study conducted on electronic records from the CPC laboratory information system (LIS), from January 1, 2021 to December 31, 2025. Qualitative detection of HR-HPV was performed on patients' cervical samples by real-time PCR (Abbott m2000), detecting 14 genotypes: 16, 18, and twelve other high-risk genotypes grouped together (31, 33, 35, 39, 45, 51, 52, 56, 58, 59, 66, 68). Analyses were performed using R version 4.0.5, with a chi-square test to assess the association between categorized age and genotype, the significance threshold being set at p

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background The human papillomavirus (high-risk, HR-HPV) is the leading cause of nearly all cervical cancers, whose burden remains particularly high in sub-Saharan Africa. This study aimed to describe the prevalence and distribution of HR-HPV genotypes among patients referred to the Centre Pasteur du Cameroun (CPC) between 2021 and 2025, and to assess the association between age and the genotype identified. Methods Analytical cross-sectional study conducted on electronic records from the CPC laboratory information system (LIS), from January 1, 2021 to December 31, 2025. Analyses were performed using R version 4.0.5, with a chi-square test to assess the association between categorized age and genotype, the significance threshold being set at p

papers.title: A novel approach to HPV16 VLP construction and production with improved accessibility and particle sorting potential
papers.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV), a member of the Papillomaviridae family, infects a broad range of animal hosts and is responsible for the majority of cervical cancers and a substantial proportion of oropharyngeal cancers. Current treatment strategies for HPV-associated cervical disease depend largely on disease stage, with preinvasive and early invasive lesions commonly managed through surgical excision or radiation. Additionally, more advanced cases often require chemotherapy, immunotherapy, or combination regimens. Prophylactic vaccination remains the most effective preventive approach, and currently available vaccines, including Gardasil, Gardasil-9, and Cervarix, rely on L1-based virus-like particles (VLPs) to induce protective immunity. At the same time, increasing interest has emerged in the use of nanomaterials and viral capsids as platforms for targeted drug and gene delivery, alongside the development of higher-throughput methods for nanoparticle and viral characterization. Modified HPV capsids have shown promise for cell-specific targeting and more efficient cargo delivery with reduced off-target cytotoxicity. In this study, the HPV16 structural proteins L1 and L2 were fused to the N- and C-terminal halves of the Venus fluorophore, respectively, using a specially designed linker intended to preserve capsid assembly while reducing VLP aggregation associated with current production methods. The resulting bimolecular fluorescence complementation (BiFC)-based VLPs demonstrated reduced aggregation and improved total particle yield. In addition, the particles generated a detectable YFP signal, supporting fluorescence-based monitoring of VLP assembly and providing a potential basis for high-throughput particle characterization and sorting. This intrinsic fluorescent signal may also reduce reliance on separately packaged reporter constructs for downstream analysis.

papers.title_zh: 一种 HPV16 VLP 构建和生产的新方法,具有改进的可及性和颗粒分选潜力
papers.source_body_en: Human papillomavirus (HPV), a member of the Papillomaviridae family, infects a broad range of animal hosts and is responsible for the majority of cervical cancers and a substantial proportion of oropharyngeal cancers. Current treatment strategies for HPV-associated cervical disease depend largely on disease stage, with preinvasive and early invasive lesions commonly managed through surgical excision or radiation. Additionally, more advanced cases often require chemotherapy, immunotherapy, or combination regimens. Prophylactic vaccination remains the most effective preventive approach, and currently available vaccines, including Gardasil, Gardasil-9, and Cervarix, rely on L1-based virus-like particles (VLPs) to induce protective immunity. At the same time, increasing interest has emerged in the use of nanomaterials and viral capsids as platforms for targeted drug and gene delivery, alongside the development of higher-throughput methods for nanoparticle and viral characterization. Modified HPV capsids have shown promise for cell-specific targeting and more efficient cargo delivery with reduced off-target cytotoxicity. In this study, the HPV16 structural proteins L1 and L2 were fused to the N- and C-terminal halves of the Venus fluorophore, respectively, using a specially designed linker intended to preserve capsid assembly while reducing VLP aggregation associated with current production methods. The resulting bimolecular fluorescence complementation (BiFC)-based VLPs demonstrated reduced aggregation and improved total particle yield. In addition, the particles generated a detectable YFP signal, supporting fluorescence-based monitoring of VLP assembly and providing a potential basis for high-throughput particle characterization and sorting. This intrinsic fluorescent signal may also reduce reliance on separately packaged reporter constructs for downstream analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 是乳头瘤病毒科的成员,可感染多种动物 宿主,并导致大多数 宫颈癌 和相当大比例的口咽癌。目前针对 HPV 相关宫颈疾病的 治疗 策略在很大程度上取决于疾病阶段,浸润前和早期浸润性病变通常通过手术切除或放射治疗。此外,更晚期的病例通常需要化疗、免疫疗法或联合疗法。预防性 疫苗接种 仍然是最有效的预防方法,目前可用的 疫苗,包括 Gardasil、Gardasil-9 和 Cervarix,依靠基于 L1 的病毒样颗粒 (VLP) 来诱导保护性免疫。与此同时,人们对使用纳米材料和病毒衣壳作为靶向药物和基因递送的平台越来越感兴趣,同时开发了用于纳米颗粒和病毒表征的高通量方法。修饰的 HPV 衣壳已显示出细胞特异性靶向和更有效的货物递送以及减少脱靶细胞毒性的前景。在这项研究中,使用专门设计的接头将 HPV16 结构蛋白 L1 和 L2 分别融合到金星荧光团的 N 端和 C 端,旨在保留衣壳组装,同时减少与当前生产方法相关的 VLP 聚集。由此产生的基于双分子荧光互补 (BiFC) 的 VLP 表现出聚集减少和总颗粒产量提高。此外,颗粒产生可检测的 YFP 信号,支持基于荧光的 VLP 组装监测,并为高通量颗粒表征和分选提供潜在基础。这种内在的荧光信号还可以减少下游分析对单独包装的报告构建体的依赖。

analysis.summary_en: This study summarizes the 2025 recommendations on human papillomavirus (HPV) screening and self-collected vaginal samples, emphasizing their role in cervical cancer prevention. The research question focused on addressing the need for effective and accessible screening methods for HPV-associated diseases. The study design involved reviewing guidelines from the Enduring Consensus Cervical Cancer Screening and Management Guidelines Committee. The methods included synthesizing evidence on the efficacy of self-collected vaginal samples for HPV detection. The main results indicated that self-collected vaginal samples are recommended for HPV screening, particularly for high-risk types like HPV16 and HPV18. The authors interpreted these findings as supporting the use of self-collected samples to improve screening adherence. The study's significance lies in its potential to inform public health strategies for cervical cancer prevention. However, the evidence is based on guidelines and may have moderate strength due to the lack of original data.

papers.abstract_zh: 本 JAMA 临床指南概要总结了 2025 年关于 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 筛查的建议以及持久共识 宫颈癌 筛查和管理指南委员会自行采集的阴道样本。
papers.summary_zh: 本 JAMA 临床指南概要总结了 2025 年关于 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 筛查的建议以及持久共识 宫颈癌 筛查和管理指南委员会自行采集的阴道样本。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在总结2025年关于人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)筛查和自行采集阴道样本的建议,以解决有效的宫颈癌预防策略的科学和公共卫生问题。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是持久共识 宫颈癌 筛查和管理指南委员会 2025 年建议的总结,重点是 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 筛查和在 宫颈癌 预防背景下自行采集的阴道样本。
analysis_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及审查和综合持久共识 宫颈癌 筛查和管理指南委员会的 2025 年建议,其中包括评估 HPV 筛查和自行收集的阴道样本在检测 HPV 相关疾病方面的功效的证据。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该研究报告称,建议使用自行采集的阴道样本进行 HPV 筛查,作为检测与 宫颈癌 相关的 高危型HPV 类型的有效方法,特别强调 HPV16 和 HPV18。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为支持使用自行采集的阴道样本进行 HPV 筛查,强调了它们在提高可及性和遵守 宫颈癌 筛查方案方面的作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以通过推广使用自行采集的阴道样本进行 HPV 筛查来为公共卫生策略提供信息,这可能会加强不同人群的 宫颈癌 预防工作。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于现有指南的总结,这可能会限制分析的深度,但由于其与既定建议的一致性,证据被认为是中等的。

papers.title: Association Between High-Risk Human Papillomavirus Infection and Vaginal Microbiota Dysbiosis Among Women
papers.abstract: Background: Cervical cancer is still one of the major causes of cancer-related deaths among women in India. It is caused by a persistent infection with a high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) type, influenced by dysbiosis. Identifying the HPV genotypes is the primary step in accurately assessing risk and developing targeted prevention and control strategies. As the HPV vaccine is not a complete protection against all HPV strains that may cause cervical cancer, regular screening is still ​‍​‌‍​‍‌​‍​‌‍​‍‌necessary. Materials and Methods: A cross-sectional study done at a hospital included 150 women of reproductive age presenting with abnormal vaginal discharge. Demographic and reproductive information were collected. Vaginal swabs were analyzed for microbiota using culture and 16S rRNA Illumina MiSeq sequencing. Cervical swabs were collected using a liquid-based cytology (LBC) kit for HPV genotyping and cytology. Statistical analysis was performed using t tests, χ2 tests, and k-means cluster analysis; P <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: The prevalence of HR-HPV was 13.33% among women; 3 samples showed multiple-genotype infection. The mean age of women was 39.66 years. The most frequently detected genotypes were HPV 68 and 59. HPV-positive and HSIL samples exhibited increased microbial diversity, including enrichment of anaerobic bacteria such as Gardnerella, Prevotella, and Dialister . Conclusions: In this hospital-based sample of symptomatic women, vaginal dysbiosis was associated with HR-HPV infection, although this finding is limited by the small number of HPV-positive cases. Whether restoring a healthy vaginal microbiota, in combination with genotype-specific HPV vaccination, could reduce the burden of HPV-related disease remains to be tested. Longitudinal and genotype-specific analytical studies are needed to elucidate causal mechanisms and regional variations.

papers.title_zh: 女性高风险 人乳头瘤病毒 感染与阴道微生物群失调之间的关联
papers.source_body_en: Background: Cervical cancer is still one of the major causes of cancer-related deaths among women in India. It is caused by a persistent infection with a high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) type, influenced by dysbiosis. Identifying the HPV genotypes is the primary step in accurately assessing risk and developing targeted prevention and control strategies. As the HPV vaccine is not a complete protection against all HPV strains that may cause cervical cancer, regular screening is still ​‍​‌‍​‍‌​‍​‌‍​‍‌necessary. Materials and Methods: A cross-sectional study done at a hospital included 150 women of reproductive age presenting with abnormal vaginal discharge. Demographic and reproductive information were collected. Vaginal swabs were analyzed for microbiota using culture and 16S rRNA Illumina MiSeq sequencing. Cervical swabs were collected using a liquid-based cytology (LBC) kit for HPV genotyping and cytology. Statistical analysis was performed using t tests, χ2 tests, and k-means cluster analysis; P <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: The prevalence of HR-HPV was 13.33% among women; 3 samples showed multiple-genotype infection. The mean age of women was 39.66 years. The most frequently detected genotypes were HPV 68 and 59. HPV-positive and HSIL samples exhibited increased microbial diversity, including enrichment of anaerobic bacteria such as Gardnerella, Prevotella, and Dialister . Conclusions: In this hospital-based sample of symptomatic women, vaginal dysbiosis was associated with HR-HPV infection, although this finding is limited by the small number of HPV-positive cases. Whether restoring a healthy vaginal microbiota, in combination with genotype-specific HPV vaccination, could reduce the burden of HPV-related disease remains to be tested. Longitudinal and genotype-specific analytical studies are needed to elucidate causal mechanisms and regional variations.

papers.title: Temporal trends in cervical cancer screening participation, barriers, HPV infection, and cytopathological profiles before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic in Cameroon
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Cervical cancer remains a major public health challenge in Cameroon, where screening uptake is limited and access is unequal. This study assessed temporal trends in cervical cancer screening, HPV infection, cytopathological findings, and factors associated with non-participation before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic. Methods A serial cross-sectional study included 3,751 women aged 25–65 years recruited from urban and rural health facilities in Cameroon between 2016 and 2024. Sociodemographic, behavioral, sociocultural, healthcare-related, and COVID-19-related data were collected using structured questionnaires. Cervical samples underwent cytological examination using the Bethesda system and HPV genotyping. Temporal patterns were examined across pre-pandemic (2016–2019), pandemic (2020–2021), and post-pandemic (2022–2024) periods. Logistic regression and multiple correspondence analysis were used to identify factors associated with non-participation in screening. Results Screening uptake declined during the pandemic period and subsequently increased, while remaining consistently lower among rural than urban women. HPV prevalence also declined over the study period, with HPV-16 and HPV-18 among the most frequently detected genotypes. LSIL and HSIL were observed in 9.0% and 4.0% of participants, respectively. Non-participation was associated with rural residence, lack of health insurance, fear of gynecological examination, preference for traditional medicine, and fear of COVID-19-related exposure. Conclusion Cervical cancer screening in Cameroon is shaped by interconnected geographic, socioeconomic, sociocultural, and health-system barriers. Strengthening decentralized, affordable, culturally appropriate screening services is essential, particularly for rural and vulnerable populations.

papers.title_zh: 喀麦隆 COVID-19 大流行之前、期间和之后 宫颈癌 筛查参与、障碍、HPV 感染和细胞病理学特征的时间趋势
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Cervical cancer remains a major public health challenge in Cameroon, where screening uptake is limited and access is unequal. This study assessed temporal trends in cervical cancer screening, HPV infection, cytopathological findings, and factors associated with non-participation before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic. Methods A serial cross-sectional study included 3,751 women aged 25–65 years recruited from urban and rural health facilities in Cameroon between 2016 and 2024. Sociodemographic, behavioral, sociocultural, healthcare-related, and COVID-19-related data were collected using structured questionnaires. Cervical samples underwent cytological examination using the Bethesda system and HPV genotyping. Temporal patterns were examined across pre-pandemic (2016–2019), pandemic (2020–2021), and post-pandemic (2022–2024) periods. Logistic regression and multiple correspondence analysis were used to identify factors associated with non-participation in screening. Results Screening uptake declined during the pandemic period and subsequently increased, while remaining consistently lower among rural than urban women. HPV prevalence also declined over the study period, with HPV-16 and HPV-18 among the most frequently detected genotypes. LSIL and HSIL were observed in 9.0% and 4.0% of participants, respectively. Non-participation was associated with rural residence, lack of health insurance, fear of gynecological examination, preference for traditional medicine, and fear of COVID-19-related exposure. Conclusion Cervical cancer screening in Cameroon is shaped by interconnected geographic, socioeconomic, sociocultural, and health-system barriers. Strengthening decentralized, affordable, culturally appropriate screening services is essential, particularly for rural and vulnerable populations.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 宫颈癌 仍然是喀麦隆的一项重大公共卫生挑战,该国筛查的普及率有限且获取机会不平等。本研究评估了 宫颈癌 筛查、HPV 感染、细胞病理学结果以及在 COVID-19 大流行之前、期间和之后与不参与相关的因素的时间趋势。方法进行了一项连续横断面研究,纳入 2016 年至 2024 年间从喀麦隆城乡卫生机构招募的 3,751 名 25-65 岁女性。使用结构化问卷收集社会人口、行为、社会文化、医疗保健相关和 COVID-19 相关数据。使用 Bethesda 系统和 HPV 基因分型对宫颈样本进行细胞学检查。对大流行前(2016-2019)、大流行(2020-2021)和大流行后(2022-2024)时期的时间模式进行了检查。使用逻辑回归和多重对应分析来确定与不参与筛查相关的因素。结果 在大流行期间筛查率下降,随后又上升,但农村女性的筛查率始终低于城市女性。HPV 患病率 在研究期间也有所下降,其中 HPV-16 和 HPV-18 是最常检测到的基因型。LSIL 和 HSIL 分别在 9.0% 和 4.0% 的参与者中观察到。不参与与居住在农村、缺乏健康保险、害怕妇科检查、偏爱传统医学以及害怕接触 COVID-19 相关。结论 喀麦隆的 宫颈癌 筛查受到相互关联的地理、社会经济、社会文化和卫生系统障碍的影响。加强分散的、负担得起的、文化上适当的筛查服务至关重要,特别是对于农村和弱势群体而言。

papers.title: Parental willingness to vaccinate daughters against human papillomavirus and associated factors in Injibara Town, Northwest Ethiopia
papers.abstract: Abstract Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination is currently recommended as prevention strategy for cervical cancer. Parental permission is significantly important to increase HPV vaccination coverage among target daughters. This study aimed to assess parental willingness to vaccinate daughters against human papillomavirus and associated factors in Injibara town, Northwest Ethiopia, 2025. A Community-based cross-sectional convergent mixed-methods study was conducted from February 20 to March 20, 2025. For quantitative and qualitative studies, 403 and 12 participants were recruited using simple random and purposive samplings, respectively. An interviewer-administered structured questionnaire tool was used to collect quantitative data. Multi-variable binary logistics regression was employed to identify factors associated with the outcome variable. An adjusted odd ratio with the corresponding 95% confidence interval was used to measure strengths of associations and statistical associations were declared at p-values less than 0.05. Qualitative data were collected using topic guide by in-depth interview technique and were coded, transcribed verbatim, and analysed thematically. The overall parental willingness to vaccinate daughters against HPV was found to be 75.7% (95% CI: 71.2%-79.9%). Daughters’ perceived health status (AOR = 4.51, 95% CI: 2.25-9.00), childhood vaccination (AOR = 2.05, 95% CI: 1.19–3.53), knowledge on HPV (AOR = 2.27, 95% CI: 1.18–4.37), and attitude (AOR = 2.15, 95% CI: 1.23–3.77) were factors associated. Misconceptions on vaccine side effects, information gaps and limited access to additional vaccination sites were barriers of willingness to vaccinate daughters. Approximately three-quarters of parents were willing to vaccinate daughters against HPV which is moderately promising compared with other findings. Daughters’ perceived health status, childhood vaccination, knowledge, and attitude on HPV were significantly associated factors. Qualitative study complemented these findings by revealing misinformation like fear of infertility, inadequate knowledge, and limited access to vaccine sites outside of school-based programs as barriers. The results collectively suggest that parental willingness to vaccinate daughters against HPV could be enhanced through improving parental attitudes and knowledge, addressing myths through reliable means of communication, and expanding vaccination sites outside of school settings.

papers.title: HPV16 transcriptional patterns in oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma with different clinical outcomes
papers.abstract: Abstract Human papillomavirus (HPV) 16 is the leading cause of oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) in many Western countries. Although patients with HPV16-positive OPSCC generally have better outcomes than those with HPV-negative disease, significant heterogeneity exists, and a subset of these patients still experience poor prognosis. The contribution of viral gene expression patterns to this heterogeneity remains unclear. In this study, deep RNA sequencing was performed on laser-capture microdissected archival tumor samples from 50 HPV-positive OPSCC patients with known clinical outcomes (29 good prognosis, 21 poor prognosis). RNA sequencing confirmed HPV16 in 40 cases (22 good prognosis, 18 poor prognosis), which were included in the HPV16-specific transcriptional analyses. Residual microbial reads were additionally assessed as a quality-control measure. Higher relative E6 expression and more frequent absence of L1 and E5 transcripts were observed in the poor-prognosis group. These associations were nominally significant in the primary analyses but did not remain statistically significant after false discovery rate correction. In exploratory regression analyses adjusted for advanced nodal stage, higher relative E6 expression and absence of E5 and L1 remained nominally associated with poor prognosis. Sensitivity analysis excluding the 25% of HPV16-positive samples with the lowest total HPV read counts strengthened the observed E6 difference but attenuated the associations for E5 and L1 transcript absence. Overall, this exploratory study identifies HPV16 transcriptional differences between OPSCC tumors from patients with different clinical outcomes. These findings are hypothesis-generating and require validation in larger, independent cohorts before prognostic or clinical relevance can be inferred.

papers.title_zh: 具有不同临床结果的口咽鳞状细胞癌中的 HPV16 转录模式
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Human papillomavirus (HPV) 16 is the leading cause of oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) in many Western countries. Although patients with HPV16-positive OPSCC generally have better outcomes than those with HPV-negative disease, significant heterogeneity exists, and a subset of these patients still experience poor prognosis. The contribution of viral gene expression patterns to this heterogeneity remains unclear. In this study, deep RNA sequencing was performed on laser-capture microdissected archival tumor samples from 50 HPV-positive OPSCC patients with known clinical outcomes (29 good prognosis, 21 poor prognosis). RNA sequencing confirmed HPV16 in 40 cases (22 good prognosis, 18 poor prognosis), which were included in the HPV16-specific transcriptional analyses. Residual microbial reads were additionally assessed as a quality-control measure. Higher relative E6 expression and more frequent absence of L1 and E5 transcripts were observed in the poor-prognosis group. These associations were nominally significant in the primary analyses but did not remain statistically significant after false discovery rate correction. In exploratory regression analyses adjusted for advanced nodal stage, higher relative E6 expression and absence of E5 and L1 remained nominally associated with poor prognosis. Sensitivity analysis excluding the 25% of HPV16-positive samples with the lowest total HPV read counts strengthened the observed E6 difference but attenuated the associations for E5 and L1 transcript absence. Overall, this exploratory study identifies HPV16 transcriptional differences between OPSCC tumors from patients with different clinical outcomes. These findings are hypothesis-generating and require validation in larger, independent cohorts before prognostic or clinical relevance can be inferred.

papers.title: Frequency of Human Papillomavirus in Patients Attending Paropakar Maternityand Women’s Hospital, Nepal
papers.abstract: Introduction: Cervical cancer remains a major cause of morbidity and mortality in Nepal. Human Papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the primary etiological factor. This study aimed to determine the frequency of HPV infection among women attending a tertiary care gynecological outpatient department in Kathmandu. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted at Paropakar Maternity and Women’s Hospital over three months. A total of 185 married or sexually active women aged 30–60 years were enrolled. Cervical samples were collected and tested for HPV DNA, including high-risk genotypes HPV-16 and HPV-18. Sociodemographic and clinical data were collected. Data analysis was performed using SPSS v26, applying chi-square and ANOVA tests, with p < 0.05 considered significant. Results: Of 185 women, 172 (93.0%) were HPV negative. Thirteen (7.0%) tested positive: HPV-16 in 7 (3.8%), HPV-18 in 3 (1.6%), and other types in 3 (1.6%). HPV positivity was more frequent in women aged 50–59 years. We found that postmenopausal women were significantly more likely to have HPV infection than premenopausal women. No significant associations were found with parity, smoking, or age at marriage. Conclusions: HPV was detected in 7%, with HPV-16 being the most common genotype. These findings underscore the importance of strengthening screening and vaccination programs in Nepal.
papers.journal: Journal of Menopause Society of Nepal

papers.title_zh: 尼泊尔帕罗帕卡妇产医院患者中 人乳头瘤病毒 的频率
papers.source_body_en: Introduction: Cervical cancer remains a major cause of morbidity and mortality in Nepal. Human Papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the primary etiological factor. This study aimed to determine the frequency of HPV infection among women attending a tertiary care gynecological outpatient department in Kathmandu. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted at Paropakar Maternity and Women’s Hospital over three months. A total of 185 married or sexually active women aged 30–60 years were enrolled. Cervical samples were collected and tested for HPV DNA, including high-risk genotypes HPV-16 and HPV-18. Sociodemographic and clinical data were collected. Data analysis was performed using SPSS v26, applying chi-square and ANOVA tests, with p < 0.05 considered significant. Results: Of 185 women, 172 (93.0%) were HPV negative. Thirteen (7.0%) tested positive: HPV-16 in 7 (3.8%), HPV-18 in 3 (1.6%), and other types in 3 (1.6%). HPV positivity was more frequent in women aged 50–59 years. We found that postmenopausal women were significantly more likely to have HPV infection than premenopausal women. No significant associations were found with parity, smoking, or age at marriage. Conclusions: HPV was detected in 7%, with HPV-16 being the most common genotype. These findings underscore the importance of strengthening screening and vaccination programs in Nepal.
papers.abstract_zh: 引言:宫颈癌仍然是尼泊尔发病率和死亡率的主要原因。人乳头瘤病毒(人乳头瘤病毒)感染是主要的病因。本研究旨在确定在加德满都三级妇产科门诊就诊的女性中人乳头瘤病毒感染的频率。方法:在帕罗帕卡尔妇产医院进行了为期三个月的横断面研究。共纳入185名30至60岁之间的已婚或有性生活的女性。收集宫颈样本并检测人乳头瘤病毒DNA,包括高危型病毒HPV-16和HPV-18。同时收集了社会人口学和临床数据。使用SPSS v26进行数据分析,采用卡方检验和方差分析,p < 0.05被认为具有统计学意义。结果:在185名女性中,172名(93.0%)为HPV阴性。13名(7.0%)为HPV阳性:其中7名(3.8%)为HPV-16阳性,3名(1.6%)为HPV-18阳性,其余3名(1.6%)为其他类型。HPV阳性在50至59岁女性中更为常见。我们发现绝经后女性比绝经前女性更有可能感染HPV。未发现与生育次数、吸烟或初婚年龄有显著关联。结论:7%的女性检测出HPV感染,其中HPV-16是最常见的基因型。这些发现强调了在尼泊尔加强筛查和疫苗接种项目的重要性。

papers.title: Diagnostic accuracy of high-risk HPV DNA and cytology in diagnosing precancerous and early malignant cervical lesions: a protocol for a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Persistent infection with high-risk hr-HPV is a major cause in the aetiopathogenesis of cervical cancer. Early detection by screening is the best strategy for prevention. Two major screening techniques hr-HPV DNA and Pap smear, target the disease condition at two different timepoints in the natural progression of cervical cancer, one at the initial stage and the other at the level of cytological changes, respectively. Our objectives are to determine the diagnostic accuracy of hr-HPV DNA testing and compare it with that of Pap smear and co-testing in detecting early cancer lesions. We will search electronic databases, including MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane, and Scopus for studies that reported the diagnostic accuracy of hr-HPV DNA testing alone or in combination with Pap in women of any age undergoing cervical cancer screening. We will include studies that evaluated WHO-prequalified HPV-DNA for the detection of precancerous (CIN1–3) and early malignant cervical lesions (FIGO Stage IA) against histopathological examination. Two reviewers will independently screen the eligible articles, and we will assess methodological quality using QUADAS-2 and QUADAS-C. A bivariate model will be used for meta-analysis to estimate summary sensitivity and specificity wherever possible. Certainty of evidence will be assessed using the GRADE approach for diagnostic test accuracy studies. We anticipate biases, challenges, heterogeneity from data, settings, and methods. However, the work aims to provide more information on the diagnostic accuracy of hr-HPV DNA tests for cervical cancer, supporting evidence-based prevention and early detection strategies. PROSPERO CRD420251251393.

papers.title: Parents perceptions and acceptability of the human papillomavirus vaccine in rural Zambia: a descriptive phenomenological study at Kabompo Hospital Affiliated Health Centre
papers.abstract: Cervical cancer is a leading cause of cancer death among women in Zambia, and vaccination of girls aged 9-14 years against human papillomavirus (HPV) is the principal primary prevention strategy. Because the vaccine is given to minors, uptake depends on parental consent, which is shaped by how parents perceive the vaccine. In Kabompo, a rural, ethnically diverse district of North-Western Province, only 59% of eligible girls had been vaccinated by 2024, well below the global target, yet no qualitative evidence existed on how parents in such settings understand and decide about the vaccine. We conducted a descriptive phenomenological study at Kabompo Hospital Affiliated Health Centre between June and August 2025. Twenty parents and legal guardians of girls aged 9-14 years were purposively selected using maximum variation sampling and interviewed in depth in English or Luvale. Interviews were audio-recorded, transcribed verbatim and analysed using Colaizzi's seven-step method with QDA Miner Lite. Five themes were generated: knowledge and awareness of HPV and its vaccine; perceptions of safety and efficacy; sociocultural and religious influences; the role of health workers; and barriers to access. Most parents knew the vaccine prevents cervical cancer, but few could explain how HPV causes cancer or state the schedule, and several first learned about the vaccine at the point of service. Fear of infertility was the most prominent concern, alongside unease that the vaccine was too new. Religious framings of divine protection, preference for herbal remedies, and concern that vaccination condones early sexual activity shaped decisions. Health workers were the most trusted source of information and were often decisive. Distance, transport costs, fear of injections and incomplete dosing limited uptake. Stated acceptability was high but did not consistently translate into vaccination, indicating an intention-behaviour gap that information campaigns alone are unlikely to close.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解赞比亚农村地区家长对 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗 的看法和接受度,鉴于 疫苗 在预防 宫颈癌(赞比亚妇女癌症死亡的主要原因)方面的重要性,解决此类环境中家长如何理解和决定 疫苗 的知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 赞比亚农村 Kabompo 医院附属健康中心进行了一项描述性现象学研究,涉及 20 名 9-14 岁女孩的父母和法定监护人,采用最大变异抽样方法进行选择。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究涉及用英语或卢瓦尔语进行的录音深度访谈,逐字转录,并使用 Colaizzi 的七步法和 QDA Miner Lite 进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究确定了五个主题:对 HPV 及其 疫苗 的知识和认识、对安全性和有效性的看法、社会文化和宗教影响、卫生工作者的作用以及获取障碍。大多数家长都知道 疫苗 可以预防 宫颈癌,但对 HPV 如何导致癌症或 疫苗接种 时间表了解有限。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,所表述的可接受性很高,但并没有始终如一地转化为 疫苗接种,这表明意图与行为之间的差距,仅靠信息宣传不太可能弥合,而且宗教和文化因素对决策有重大影响。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以通过解决知识差距和文化障碍,为提高家长理解和 疫苗 吸收的策略提供参考,特别是在农村地区。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括样本量小以及它是在单个农村卫生中心进行的,限制了普遍性。证据强度中等。

papers.title: Considerations for human papillomavirus (HPV) self-collection programs for cervical screening: a qualitative study to inform co-design of a screening trial among vulnerable women from south India
papers.abstract: Abstract Background There is a need to co-design context specific programs for cervical screening using human papillomavirus (HPV) self-collection, given the anticipated program transition to HPV screening in low- and middle-income countries. We conducted a co-design study to plan a trial of self-collection in Tamil Nadu, India, among rural, tribal and urban slum settings. Methods In 2023 we conducted nine focus group discussions among never screened women and interviewed 18 women previously screened using Visual Inspection with Acetic acid. Open inductive coding was followed by deductive framework analysis using the Capability Opportunity Motivation – Behaviour (COM-B) model to identify barriers and facilitators to self-collection. Results Never screened women reported a lack of perceived need due to being asymptomatic, fear and embarrassment, stigma and fear of cancer, low awareness and barriers to attending facilities for screening. Reasons for screening included opportunities provided by community outreach and by trusted providers/ sources of information. Self-collection was largely acceptable, perceived to be painless and easy. Women preferred self-collection at home or the community, following group-based information sessions. Some women had doubts regarding self-efficacy, fears regarding pain, or were unconvinced of the need for screening. Group education may help motivate asymptomatic women in settings where peer influence is an important factor for decision making. Conclusions Self-collection, especially if provided through group-based community outreach, would be acceptable to most women in low-resource settings. Concerted efforts are required to motivate women for screening as competing priorities and low perceived need for screening will persist even with self-collection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to co-design context-specific programs for cervical screening using HPV self-collection, addressing the anticipated transition to HPV screening in low- and middle-income countries. The background highlights the need for such programs given the existing knowledge gaps and the lack of tailored approaches for vulnerable populations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A co-design study was conducted in Tamil Nadu, India, involving nine focus group discussions with never screened women and 18 women previously screened using Visual Inspection with Acetic acid. The study aimed to identify barriers and facilitators to self-collection among rural, tribal, and urban slum settings.
analysis.methods: The study involved qualitative methods, including focus group discussions and interviews, to gather insights from women regarding their perceptions and experiences with HPV self-collection. The data were analyzed using open inductive coding and deductive framework analysis with the COM-B model.
analysis.main_results: The results indicated that never screened women reported barriers such as a lack of perceived need, fear and embarrassment, stigma, and low awareness. Self-collection was largely acceptable and perceived as painless and easy. Women preferred self-collection at home or in the community following group-based information sessions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings to suggest that self-collection, especially through group-based community outreach, would be acceptable to most women in low-resource settings. The study highlighted the importance of addressing perceived need and providing community-based education to motivate women for screening.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the design of future HPV self-collection programs for cervical screening in low-resource settings, emphasizing the need for community-based education and addressing perceived barriers to screening.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its qualitative nature and the specific context of Tamil Nadu, which may not be generalizable to other settings. The evidence strength is moderate due to the small sample size and the focus on a specific population.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to co-design context-specific programs for HPV self-collection in low-resource settings, focusing on barriers and facilitators among never screened women in Tamil Nadu, India. The findings suggest that self-collection is acceptable if provided through community outreach, but concerted efforts are needed to address perceived need and motivate women for screening.

papers.title_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 宫颈筛查自我收集计划的考虑因素:一项定性研究,旨在为印度南部弱势妇女共同设计筛查试验提供信息
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background There is a need to co-design context specific programs for cervical screening using human papillomavirus (HPV) self-collection, given the anticipated program transition to HPV screening in low- and middle-income countries. We conducted a co-design study to plan a trial of self-collection in Tamil Nadu, India, among rural, tribal and urban slum settings. Methods In 2023 we conducted nine focus group discussions among never screened women and interviewed 18 women previously screened using Visual Inspection with Acetic acid. Open inductive coding was followed by deductive framework analysis using the Capability Opportunity Motivation – Behaviour (COM-B) model to identify barriers and facilitators to self-collection. Results Never screened women reported a lack of perceived need due to being asymptomatic, fear and embarrassment, stigma and fear of cancer, low awareness and barriers to attending facilities for screening. Reasons for screening included opportunities provided by community outreach and by trusted providers/ sources of information. Self-collection was largely acceptable, perceived to be painless and easy. Women preferred self-collection at home or the community, following group-based information sessions. Some women had doubts regarding self-efficacy, fears regarding pain, or were unconvinced of the need for screening. Group education may help motivate asymptomatic women in settings where peer influence is an important factor for decision making. Conclusions Self-collection, especially if provided through group-based community outreach, would be acceptable to most women in low-resource settings. Concerted efforts are required to motivate women for screening as competing priorities and low perceived need for screening will persist even with self-collection.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 鉴于低收入和中等收入国家预计计划将向 HPV 筛查过渡,有必要利用 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 自我采集共同设计针对具体情况的宫颈筛查计划。我们进行了一项联合设计研究,计划在印度泰米尔纳德邦的农村、部落和城市贫民窟环境中进行自我收集试验。方法 2023 年,我们在从未接受过筛查的女性中进行了 9 次焦点小组讨论,并采访了 18 名之前使用醋酸目视检查进行过筛查的女性。开放归纳编码之后是使用能力机会动机-行为(COM-B)模型进行演绎框架分析,以识别自我收集的障碍和促进因素。结果 从未接受过筛查的女性报告称,由于无症状、恐惧和尴尬、对癌症的耻辱和恐惧、意识低下以及前往机构接受筛查存在障碍,因此缺乏感知需求。筛选的原因包括社区外展和值得信赖的提供者/信息来源提供的机会。自助取货基本上是可以接受的,被认为是无痛且容易的。女性更喜欢在小组信息会议后在家中或社区自行收集。一些女性对自我效能有怀疑,对疼痛感到恐惧,或者不相信需要进行筛查。在同伴影响是决策重要因素的环境中,团体教育可能有助于激励无症状女性。结论 自助收集,尤其是通过基于群体的社区外展提供的方式,对于资源匮乏地区的大多数妇女来说是可以接受的。需要共同努力来激励女性进行筛查,因为即使自行收集,筛查需求仍然存在竞争性优先事项和低感知需求。

papers.title: Cross-cohort transcriptional and network signatures of human papillomavirus-associated cancers
papers.abstract: Introduction: Persistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection contributes substantially to the global burden of virus-associated cancers, including those of the cervix, vulva, anus, penis, and oropharynx. HPV-positive tumors frequently exhibit distinct clinical characteristics. The molecular mechanisms and biomarkers that unify HPV-associated cancers across various tissue types remain poorly characterized. Materials and methods: Sixty bulk RNA-seq datasets representing three tumor types were retrieved and processed uniformly. A meta-analysis was performed to assess transcriptomic similarity among the tumor cohorts. Differential gene expression analysis was carried out to characterize HPV-positive and HPV-negative expression patterns. Weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) was performed to identify HPV-associated gene modules. Hub genes were selected using Module Membership and Gene Significance criteria and further prioritized through cohort-specific protein–protein interaction analysis. Results: Differential expression analysis identified distinct transcriptional differences associated with HPV status across all three cohorts, although the magnitude of differential expression varied between tumor types. Cross-cohort meta-analysis identified a 2959-gene transcriptional program reaching genome-wide significance under a fixed-effect model, with 557 genes remaining significant under a heterogeneity-adjusted random-effects model. Gene set enrichment analysis identified 1578 pathways reaching false discovery rate (FDR)-corrected significance, predominantly related to immune response, DNA repair, and DNA replication. WGCNA identified HPV-associated co-expression modules whose hub genes were enriched for immune regulation, adaptive immune activation, and antiviral host-defense processes. Conclusions: Integrated differential expression, heterogeneity-aware meta-analysis, and co-expression network analyses identified transcriptional patterns associated with HPV status across the included cohorts. These findings provide candidate genes and biological pathways for future validation and functional investigation in independent cohorts of HPV-associated cancers.

papers.title_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 相关癌症的跨 队列研究 转录和网络特征
papers.source_body_en: Introduction: Persistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection contributes substantially to the global burden of virus-associated cancers, including those of the cervix, vulva, anus, penis, and oropharynx. HPV-positive tumors frequently exhibit distinct clinical characteristics. The molecular mechanisms and biomarkers that unify HPV-associated cancers across various tissue types remain poorly characterized. Materials and methods: Sixty bulk RNA-seq datasets representing three tumor types were retrieved and processed uniformly. A meta-analysis was performed to assess transcriptomic similarity among the tumor cohorts. Differential gene expression analysis was carried out to characterize HPV-positive and HPV-negative expression patterns. Weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) was performed to identify HPV-associated gene modules. Hub genes were selected using Module Membership and Gene Significance criteria and further prioritized through cohort-specific protein–protein interaction analysis. Results: Differential expression analysis identified distinct transcriptional differences associated with HPV status across all three cohorts, although the magnitude of differential expression varied between tumor types. Cross-cohort meta-analysis identified a 2959-gene transcriptional program reaching genome-wide significance under a fixed-effect model, with 557 genes remaining significant under a heterogeneity-adjusted random-effects model. Gene set enrichment analysis identified 1578 pathways reaching false discovery rate (FDR)-corrected significance, predominantly related to immune response, DNA repair, and DNA replication. WGCNA identified HPV-associated co-expression modules whose hub genes were enriched for immune regulation, adaptive immune activation, and antiviral host-defense processes. Conclusions: Integrated differential expression, heterogeneity-aware meta-analysis, and co-expression network analyses identified transcriptional patterns associated with HPV status across the included cohorts. These findings provide candidate genes and biological pathways for future validation and functional investigation in independent cohorts of HPV-associated cancers.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介:持续性 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染极大地增加了全球病毒相关癌症的负担,包括宫颈癌、外阴癌、肛门癌、阴茎癌和口咽癌。HPV 阳性肿瘤经常表现出独特的临床特征。将不同组织类型中的 HPV 相关癌症统一起来的分子机制和生物标志物仍知之甚少。材料和方法:检索并统一处理代表三种肿瘤类型的 60 个批量 RNA-seq 数据集。进行荟萃分析以评估肿瘤 队列研究 之间的转录组相似性。进行差异基因表达分析来表征 HPV 阳性和 HPV 阴性表达模式。进行加权基因共表达网络分析(WGCNA)来鉴定 HPV 相关基因模块。使用模块成员资格和基因显着性标准选择中心基因,并通过 队列研究 特异性蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用分析进一步确定优先级。结果:差异表达分析确定了所有三种 队列研究 中与 HPV 状态相关的明显转录差异,尽管差异表达的程度因肿瘤类型而异。交叉 队列研究 荟萃分析确定了一个 2959 个基因的转录程序在固定效应模型下达到了 基因组 范围内的显着性,其中 557 个基因在异质性调整的随机效应模型下仍然具有显着性。基因集富集分析确定了 1578 个达到错误发现率 (FDR) 校正显着性的通路,主要与 免疫应答、DNA 修复和 DNA 复制相关。WGCNA 鉴定了 HPV 相关共表达模块,其中心基因富集用于免疫调节、适应性免疫激活和 抗病毒药物 宿主 防御过程。结论:综合差异表达、异质性感知荟萃分析和共表达网络分析确定了 队列研究 中与 HPV 状态相关的转录模式。这些发现为 HPV 相关癌症的独立 队列研究 的未来验证和功能研究提供了候选基因和生物学途径。
